the experience of taking care of the caregivers in their working setting, can promote self care and the feeling of been valued and can stimulate the development of the self care in their working environment.
the experience of the care of the self in the work environment is an important element to be considered in the nursing practice.

the experience of taking care of the caregiver is very positive for the caregivers and it is important to stimulate the sensitivities towards the care of the self in order to improve the quality of care provided to others.

the importance of the self care in the working environment and the importance of the nursing teams to be taken care of in order to be able to take care of the other.
the promotion of the self care of nurses, which is a fundamental aspect of the professional practice and of the quality of the care provided to the patients.
a new way of understanding the self care and the importance of its practice in the daily life of a nurse.

the experience made in this study was a positive one for the subjects involved, and it could be considered as a starting point to promote self care in other working environments.
the actions of care towards the self could be a strategy to promote the self care and to prevent burnout.

this kind of experience is important for all the nursing team, specially the nurses, to develop their self care and also to practice it with the other professionals in the work setting, which could be a way of promoting the quality of the nursing care.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the self care of the caregivers is an action of great importance in the nursing care and it is necessary to promote it in the working environment.
it is possible to promote the self care in the working environment, and this could be done through a process of sensitiveness, awareness and reflection.
it is necessary to take care of the caregiver, to value him and to stimulate his self care in order to have a better working environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the care of the caregiver can be promoted by the nurse and the team in a working environment.
it is possible to promote the self care in the working setting and it is a necessary condition to promote the care towards the patients.
the nursing team should be aware of the importance of the self care and the care towards the self and the others.
